description: Parse a semantic version into major/minor/patch/prerelease, test it against a SemVer range (^, ~, >=, *) and compare two versions with the exact upgrade class (major/minor/patch/prerelease). Deterministic — no approximating precedence rules from memory. Use this when an agent needs to parse, compare and range-test versions. x402 price $0.002/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: dev_semver_checker
title: SemVer Checker
